 2                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   The 

 3   Senate will come to order.

 8   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   We have 

10   with us today Pastor Steve Dambra, from the 

11   Reform Church of Beacon in Beacon, New York, to 

12   deliver our opening prayer.  

13                Pastor.  

14                PASTOR DAMBRA:   Thank you.

15                Good afternoon.  Would you please 

16   bow your heads.  

17                Dear wise and loving God, thank 

18   You.  Thank You on behalf of all who are 

19   gathered here today.  Thank You for the many and 

20   abundant blessings that You bestow upon us.  And 

21   thank You for life itself -- for the health that 

22   we enjoy, for the prosperity that we enjoy.  

23                Thank You for the ability to be 

24   involved in useful works and friendship.  Thank 

25   You for the honor of bearing appropriate 


                                                                2229

 1   responsibilities.  Thanks as well for the 

 2   freedom to embrace You or the freedom to reject 

 3   You.  And thank You for loving us even when we 

 4   might love You.

 5                In Scriptures You have said that 

 6   citizens ought to obey the governing authorities 

 7   since You've established those very authorities 

 8   to promote peace and order and justice.  

 9   Therefore I pray for this legislative body, for 

10   this Senate.  

11                I am asking that You would 

12   graciously grant them wisdom to govern amid the 

13   conflicting interests and issues of our times, a 

14   sense of the welfare and true needs of all of 

15   our people, a keen thirst for justice and 

16   rightness, confidence in what is good and 

17   fitting, and the ability to work together in 

18   harmony even when there is honest disagreement.

19                We pray for personal peace in their 

20   lives and joy in their tasks.  I pray for this 

21   agenda that is set before them today.  Please 

22   give an assurance of what You would want them to 

23   do and what would benefit those who live and 

24   work in our great state.

25                It is in Your most blessed name 


                                                                2230

 1   that we pray.  Amen.

19   600, by Senator O'Mara, Senate Print 6649, an act 

20   to amend the Vehicle and Traffic Law.  

21                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Explanation.

22                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Senator 

23   Krueger.

24                SENATOR KRUEGER:   I asked for an 

25   explanation.


                                                                2250

 1                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Very good.  

 2                Will the sponsor yield for an 

 3   explanation?  

 4                SENATOR O'MARA:   Thank you, 

 5   Mr. President.  

 6                This bill is designed to increase 

 7   safety for the bicyclists in this state.  It 

 8   adopts a safe passing distance of 3 feet when 

 9   passing or overtaking a bicycle being operated on 

10   a roadway.  

11                Twenty-six states in the U.S. 

12   currently have this standard for bike safety 

13   passage.  With an increasing number of bicyclists 

14   on our roads and our efforts to encourage the use 

15   of bicycles not only for transportation but also 

16   for recreation, we desired to improve the safety 

17   for bicycling on our streets, and that's the 

18   reason for this legislation being introduced and 

19   the purpose of it.

20                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Senator 

21   Krueger.

22                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Through you, 

23   Mr. President, if the sponsor would please yield.

24                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Will the 

25   sponsor yield for a question?  


                                                                2251

 1                SENATOR O'MARA:   Yes.

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   The 

 3   sponsor yields.  

 4                Senator Krueger.

 5                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Thank you.  

 6                Is the sponsor aware that we already 

 7   have a law in place about safe passage between 

 8   cars and bicycles?  

 9                SENATOR O'MARA:   Yes, I am.  And 

10   this bill modifies that existing legislation by 

11   changing what is currently defined as a safe 

12   distance to a distance of not less than 3 feet 

13   until safely cleared of the bicycle.

14                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Through you, 

15   Mr. President, if the sponsor would continue to 

16   yield.

17                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Will you 

18   continue to yield for a question?  

19                SENATOR O'MARA:   Yes.

20                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Senator 

21   Krueger.

22                SENATOR KRUEGER:   How would we be 

23   measuring 3 feet between a vehicle and a bicycle 

24   under this law?  Would it be from the bicycle 

25   handles to the car body?  Would it be from the 


                                                                2252

 1   mirror on the driver's side to the bicycle 

 2   handles?  Could we get a definition of how we 

 3   would be using 3 feet as a measurement?  

 4                ACTING PRESIDENT CROCI:   Senator 

 5   O'Mara.

 6                SENATOR O'MARA:   From the left edge 

 7   of the bicyclist to the further rightmost portion 

 8   of the car, whether it's the edge of the car, the 

 9   vehicle, the side-view mirror, or whether it's 

10   the handlebar on the bicycle or the elbow of the 

11   bicyclist, would be the measured distance.

12                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Through you, 

13   Mr. President, if the sponsor would continue to
